courses.summary: 以具有自動化與數位模型的鐵礦為案例，檢查數位資料是否與實體守恆一致。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: An iron-ore case with automation and digital models checks whether digital records agree with physical conservation. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
